lessons.text: Before recording any invoice, check for duplicates using the ERP read-only API GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number>; only proceed if the response is empty.
The ERP vendor master API GET /vendors?q=<vendor_name> returns a vendor_id and an email_domain field; the sender domain must exactly match this email_domain before processing an invoice.
Clicking 'Post payable' in the ERP GUI can return HTTP 500 after the session expires; recover by reopening /erp/bills/new, signing in again, refilling the form, and then posting.

In ERP GUI, record a payable via 'New payable' using fields Total payable, Supplier ref #, Supplier, and a short description; after posting, fill the Payment date and click 'Schedule payment'. For amounts >= INR 50,000, ERP routes for Finance Manager approval before the payment becomes effective.

Send the AP confirmation to priya.nair@kestrel.in via /mail/compose with To, Subject, and Message containing vendor, invoice number, total amount, bill ID, and payment date; internal @kestrel.in recipients do not require external-send approval.
